reference.question: Given $y=(x+3)/(2x-1)$, what is the value of $y$ when $x=-1$? (Write as a fraction in lowest terms.)
reference.solution:
Method 1: Evaluate the numerator and denominator

Substituting gives $(-1+3)/(2\times(-1)-1)=2/(-3)=-2/3$.
